body: Found while fixing tsk_01a12074f9e37474b762abe67088e6f6 (no user request yet). Capture -> rule sync is async, so a cookie set on a redirect is not on the request that follows it; on the local fixture every sign-in needs one retry (e2e-signin counts it). Written up in docs/limits.md, not fixed.
title: Set-Cookie on a 302 in a persona tab misses the immediate follow-up request
